headline: Lee Minseung gains 9.16 to climb from 37th to 27th on ARC-AGI-2

sections.text: Lee Minseung gained 9.16 points to reach 59.58 on ARC-AGI-2, moving from 37th to 27th in the past day.
The score remains below the gold line, the score at 16th, which rose to 67.50 in the past day. Public standings are provisional and medals are decided on the private board.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
